?getIdentifier@CooldownItemComponent@@SA.what: a zero-argument magic-statics accessor: a HashedString built once in JS from the literal "minecraft:cooldown" (2024 baseline body at 0x1e01750), then the same reference returned forever after -- itemComponentIdentifier() in implements.ts, shared by all nineteen *ItemComponent names in this family
routes: the 2024 body for all nineteen is the same shape (disas-exact against 1.21.3.01, e.g. FuelItemComponent 0x1e01d80): a thread-safe magic-statics guard (`_Init_thread_header`), then `HashedString::HashedString(char const*)` over a fixed string literal, `atexit`, and a reference to that one instance returned forever after -- a zero-argument static with no observable state but the literal itself

no out-of-line 1.26 copy exists for any of the nineteen on either build (every call site inlines the literal instead, e.g. "minecraft:fuel" lea'd straight into CoalItem's constructor on both 1.26.40.8 and 1.26.51.1) -- confirmed by the address the table had shipped for Fuel being retracted (a four-argument string-building function, not this shape at all)

the second, independent route: every one of the nineteen literals still exists exactly once in each 1.26 image (a plain byte search of work/bin/<v>/bedrock_server.exe, all 19 x2 builds = count=1) -- the 2024 body says what string a class returns, the 1.26 binary says that exact string is still there
